name: competitor-intel
title_zh: 竞品底牌翻给你看，连它下一步都推给你
tagline_zh: 不用翻财报、不用猜动向，它把竞品的真实数据、可下手杠杆和下一步动作摆到你面前，像雇了个只盯对手的侦察兵。
tagline_en: Skip the guesswork. Get verified competitor metrics, actionable leverage angles, and predicted next moves—like a.
desc_en: Analyzes competitors using web research to provide verified business metrics, actionable leverage strategies, and predicted next moves. Use when user needs competitive intelligence, competitor analysis, market positioning insights, or strategic leverage opportunities.
why_zh: 不是罗列新闻，而是把零散信息拼成可行动的杠杆点，并预测对手动向，让你从被动防守变成主动出牌。
why_en: Not a news dump. It synthesizes scattered intel into concrete leverage points and forecasts rival moves, flipping you from.
limit_zh: 只做桌面研究，不碰内部数据；预测基于公开信息，准确率看行业透明度；结果到策略建议为止，不代你执行。
limit_en: Desk research only, no insider data. Predictions rely on public info; accuracy varies by industry. Output stops at strategic suggestions, no.
title_en: Flip a competitor's cards: real metrics, leverage, next.
